dependencies.scope: cap-preserving C_c_infinity approximation and exact equality of full and smooth-input interval constants
every rank-at-least-three cap-one product quadratic has a bounded continuous density for each fixed matrix

new_result.statement: The optimal full target density constant equals the optimal constant restricted simultaneously to compactly supported smooth cap-one marginals and fully generic symmetric matrices with simple spectrum, all nonempty principal minors nonzero, and three protected eigenvalues strictly outside [-1,1].

partner_result_applied.application: After interval domination is transferred to the original rough target law, continuity gives p(t)=lim_{h->0} mu((t-h,t+h))/(2h)<=C pointwise.

unresolved_implication: Prove one matrix-, dimension-, support-, smoothness-, and reciprocal-minor-independent density height bound on the smooth fully-generic subclass; this would now imply the full theorem with exactly the same constant.
next_step: Combine the new regular-class reduction with the ridge-window/diffuse theorem and attack only the complementary high-leverage heavy-coordinate regime, without paying one reciprocal principal minor.
